decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through the use of removal spells, hand disruption, and graveyard interaction. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also generating value through cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Bitter Triumph and Culling Ritual to maintain card advantage and board presence. By leveraging the strength of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, this deck seeks to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy matchup.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler, Fiend Artisan, and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu to quickly build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes mana ramp with Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for additional mana generation. The deck includes a mix of creature types and abilities to keep the opponent on their toes, while also incorporating some utility lands like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures for added versatility.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push, Duress, and Thoughtseize. By utilizing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Graveyard Trespasser, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, it aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain board control. The inclusion of Liliana of the Veil, Kolaghan's Command, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provides additional value and flexibility in different situations. The deck also includes utility lands like Mutavault and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to support its aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger. Use spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board and deal direct damage. Academic Dispute and Flow State provide card advantage and help keep the pressure on your opponent. With a mix of burn spells, aggressive creatures, and card draw, this deck aims to win the game quickly by maintaining a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenixes from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Treasure Cruise and Artist's Talent to constantly cycle through the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, using cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to deal damage and clear the way for the Phoenixes to attack. The versatility of cards like Opt and Prismari Command allow for adaptability in different situations, while Picklock Prankster provides additional support for the aggro strategy.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by countering their key spells, removing their threats, and drawing additional cards to stay ahead. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Thor, God of Thunder and Gran-Gran helps to provide additional threats while maintaining control of the game. By utilizing a mix of spells and creatures, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies that aim to quickly deal damage to the opponent and overwhelm them before they can stabilize. It includes a mix of cheap and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, alongside burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. Cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and The Legend of Roku provide additional reach and finishing power. The deck also utilizes lands like Ramunap Ruins and Mutavault for extra damage. Overall, the goal is to be fast and relentless in attacking the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by quickly deploying low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy revolves around using instants and sorceries to trigger prowess abilities on creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while maintaining control through removal spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. By combining creature aggression with direct damage spells, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent and close out the game efficiently.

This deck focuses on using the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm your opponent. It utilizes cards like Concealed Courtyard and Temple Garden to generate the necessary mana, while also including disruption like Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality to control the game. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and leverage them to gain a significant advantage over the opponent. With the right sequencing and planning, this deck has the potential to be a highly competitive force in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly build up a board presence and deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. The deck focuses on low-cost creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board and clear a path for attacking. By utilizing cards like Flow State and Emberheart Challenger, the deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game, while also taking advantage of multicolor lands like Riverpyre Verge and Steam Vents for flexibility in casting spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The deck also utilizes card draw and additional creature buffs such as Flow State and Monstrous Rage to maintain pressure on the opponent. By combining efficient creatures with direct damage spells and card advantage, this deck aims to take control of the game early and maintain its aggressive momentum to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm opponents. By utilizing cards like Agadeem's Awakening and Bitter Triumph to support the combo pieces, as well as cards like Cache Grab and Collective Brutality for control and disruption, the goal is to establish a dominating board presence and win the game swiftly. The deck also includes a variety of lands and creatures to support the strategy and ensure consistent and efficient gameplay.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence with versatile creatures like Badgermole Cub and Mutavault. The deck also utilizes lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to give it an edge in certain matchups. With a mix of removal, disruption, and threats, this deck seeks to outmaneuver its opponents and grind out victories.

The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo involving Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. Using cards like Bitter Triumph and Cache Grab to manipulate the top of the deck, Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy, and creatures like Yathan Roadwatcher and Thundering Broodwagon to provide support. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Jennifer Walters and powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance the combo potential. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and synergistic combination of cards.

This UW Control deck focuses on long-term value and disruption, using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Dovin's Veto to control the game. The deck also includes plenty of card draw and selection in cards like Omen of the Sea and Consult the Star Charts. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in the late game. The deck aims to outvalue opponents with powerful threats like Ultima and March of Otherworldly Light while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells.

The main concept of this deck revolves around building up green devotion to quickly power out strong creatures and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilising cards like Nature's Rhythm, Llanowar Elves, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck aims to generate mana quickly to cast powerful threats like Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu and Spider Manifestation. Additionally, the deck includes support cards like Enduring Vitality and Fiend Artisan to provide additional utility and resilience in combat. Overall, the goal is to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent with a consistent stream of threats.
